name: Gaia -Save the Earth-
source:
Pollution levels hit their limit in the 21st century causing water, air and soil contamination, as well as global warming.
At such time goddess Gaia appears in the sky with the power of love to save the Earth. She chooses a savior who must bring together powers of heroines from five different countries. And that savior is you.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
21世纪，污染程度达到极限，水、空气与土壤均遭到严重污染，全球变暖也愈演愈烈。
就在此时，女神盖亚带着爱的力量出现在天空，准备拯救地球。她选中一名救世主，要求此人汇聚来自五个不同国家的女主角之力。而那名救世主就是你。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
